cards.title: Act Like You Belong
cards.instruction: You do not understand what is happening. Copy the confidence around you and never admit confusion.

cards.title: Warmth with a Countdown
cards.instruction: Perform increasing warmth with increasingly final language, as though every act of care might also be a goodbye.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I've packed six lunches like the coach driver. You'll be well fed when you leave us.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: His lunches are for six passengers. I'm visiting my sister in the next town for one afternoon.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Exactly, plenty to share. Give her one with my love, and keep the others for whatever comes after.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: I'm coming back on the four o'clock bus. Keep dinner for me.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll wrap your favourite dinner too. Then you'll have something of home even if the four o'clock is the last bus you take this way.
